{"format":"org.dxos.dx-svg@1","version":1,"root":"00000000000005GNDWWX3WT0GM","source":{"language":"dsl","text":"diagram @ -128,-64 flow=down box=256x128 grid=384x192
group entry "Entry" {
  node Entry "Entrypoints" ref="edge/packages/services/compute-service/src/entrypoint"
  node Triggers "triggers" ref="edge/packages/services/compute-service/src/triggers"
  node Process "ProcessObject" ref="edge/packages/services/compute-service/src/processes/process-object.ts"
  node Workflow "WorkflowExecutor" ref="edge/packages/services/compute-service/src/workflow/workflow-executor.ts"
}
group exec "Execution" {
  node Scheduler "Scheduler DO" ref="edge/packages/services/compute-service/src/triggers/scheduler-object.ts"
  node Invoker "FunctionInvoker" ref="edge/packages/services/compute-service/src/invocation/function-invoker.ts"
  node Runtime "Fn runtime" ref="edge/packages/services/compute-service/src/runtime"
  node Registry "FunctionsRegistry" ref="edge/packages/services/compute-service/src/registry/functions-registry.ts"
  node Logger "FunctionsLogger" ref="edge/packages/services/compute-service/src/functions-logger/functions-logger.ts"
}
group bindings "Bindings" {
  node Store "D1 + R2" ref="edge/packages/services/compute-service/wrangler.jsonc"
  node Ext "db / ai / kms" ref="edge/packages/services"
}
edge Entry -> Invoker "invoke"
edge Triggers -> Scheduler "dispatch"
edge Scheduler -> Invoker "fire"
edge Process -> Invoker "spawn"
edge Workflow -> Invoker "steps"
edge Invoker -> Runtime "load"
edge Runtime -> Logger "tail logs"
edge Runtime -> Store "loader"
edge Registry -> Store "upload"
edge Invoker -> Ext "services"
"},"objects":[
